dataLayers.name: raw
dataLayers.targetRule: Every material civic artifact must be registered by the universal source/artifact registry.

dataLayers.name: interim
dataLayers.targetRule: Never a source of truth; reproducible from source/canonical state.

dataLayers.name: processed
dataLayers.targetRule: Must be reproducible from registered source/canonical state.

dataLayers.name: curated
dataLayers.targetRule: Material civic facts must round-trip into canonical DB or be registered as source records/assertions.

dataLayers.name: public
dataLayers.targetRule: Must be generated from versioned public read models/policies.

dataLayers.name: sources
dataLayers.targetRule: Align with universal source registry; files may remain as auditable manifests.

dataLayers.name: geo
dataLayers.targetRule: Register as source/artifact and link to canonical geo model.

dataLayers.name: legalita
dataLayers.targetRule: Register source/evidence ownership; do not maintain a separate ontology from canonical crime/legal domains.
